Ungriano: This has reference to your email letter dated 18 October 2024 addressed to the Presidential Action Center (PACE) and subsequently endorsed to DILG, with regard to your query on the grant of the Service Recognition Incentive (SRI) for Fiscal Year 2023. Service Recognition Incentive (SRI) is a one (1) time yearly incentive granted to qualified govemment personnel in recognition of their collective and invaluable contribution to the govemment's continuing efforts in pursuing the objectives, commitments, targets and deliverables. The Department of Budget and Management (DBM) issued Budget Circular No. 2023- 2 dated December 13, 2023 with the subject "Guidelines on the Grant of Service Recognition Incentive to Government Employees for FY 2023". Administrative Order (AO) No. 12 dated December 07, 2023 authorizes the grant of a one-time Service Recognition Incentive (SRI) for FY 2023 at a Uniform Rate not exceeding Twenty- Thousand Pesos (20,000) for each qualified employee. Further, Item 8.0 of the aforesaid budget circular states: The grant of the one-time SRI to employees in LGUs, including those in the barangays, shall be determined by their respective sanggunians depending on the LGU's financial capability, at a uniform rate not exceeding Twenty-Thousand Pesos (20,000) each, subject to the following conditions: 8.1 The SRI shall be charged against their respective local government funds, subject to the PS limitation in LGU budgets pursuant to Sections 325 (a) and 331 (b) of RA No. 7160 or the Local Government Code of 1991; 8.2 The guidelines on the grant of the SRI under Item 5.0 of this Circular shall be adhered to; and 8.3 In determining the amount of the SRI, the sanggunians shall exercise prudence and judicious use of government funds, ensuring that the expenditure "Matino, Mahusay, at Maaasahan" Tel. is reasonable and will not, in any way, adversely affect the delivery of services to the public. Should the identified funding source prove insufficient to cover the maximum allowable rate of the SRI, a lower but uniform amount shall be granted to all qualified employees of the LGU. The amount required shall be chargeable against the available FY 2023 appropriations or surplus upon the enactment by the local sanggunian of the corresponding supplemental budget (SB) for the purposo. In case tho LGU fails to enact an SB within FY 2023, the LGU concerned may enact an SB for FY 2024, provided that the (j) SB shall be charged against the LGU's reverted and unused surplus for prior years, subject to compliance with pertinent provisions of RA No. 7160, and other existing laws, rules and regulations; (ii) prior year's surplus is backed by cash; and (iii) annual budget for FY 2024 is already approved. Further, consistent with Sections 325(a) and 331 (b) of RA No. 7160 and the existing local govemment budgeting rules and regulations, in the enactment of an SB, the I-GIJ concerned shall be further guided by the following in the determination of PS limitation for the grant of the SRI: (i) SBs passed in 2023 shall be subject to compliance with the PS limitation for FY 2023; and (ii) SBs passed in 2024 shall be subject to compliance with the PS limitation for FY 2024. Based on the facts you have presented, we are of the opinion that you are entitled to a one (1) time grant of the Service Recognition Incentive subject to your respective LGU's financial capability at a uniform rate not exceeding Twenty-Thousand Pesos (20,000). This view is based solely on the facts you have presented and without prejudice to the authoritative decision of the courts of competent jurisdiction. Hope we have enlightened you on the matter. Very truly yours, BY AUTHORITY—ETHE SECRETARY: ATTY. ROMEO P. BENITEZ Undersecretary for Extemal, Legal and Legislative Affairs CC: ATTY. IZZA MARI D. I-AURIO Director.
